operators.name: fused_sqrt_round
semantics: Computes torch.sqrt(x) elementwise, then torch.round on the result.
Preserves input shape, strides, and device; output tensor is allocated with same shape/dtype/device as input.
No broadcasting, no reduction; exactly one output element per input element.
Input must be non-negative to match reference sqrt domain; implementation may rely on standard sqrt behavior.
Order of operations: sqrt before round, as in reference.

operators.name: conv_transpose2d_forward
semantics: Performs 2D transposed convolution (conv_transpose2d) exactly as torch.nn.ConvTranspose2d.forward with given parameters.
Uses cuDNN backend, as mandated for Conv/ConvTranspose.
Bias is added after convolution if not None; if bias is None, no bias term.
stride, padding, output_padding are scalars applied symmetrically to both spatial dimensions.
Input, weight, bias are CUDA tensors; output is allocated on same device and stream.
Supports arbitrary strides; internally ensures appropriate memory layout for cuDNN, copying if necessary.
No groups (groups=1), no dilation (dilation=1).
Elementwise square root of input tensor x.
Input shape [512,3,40,40], dtype float32, device cuda.
Output shape identical, dtype float32, device cuda.
No broadcasting, no reduction.
Elementwise rounding to nearest integer, ties rounded to even (default behavior).
Input shape [512,3,40,40], dtype float32, device cuda.
Output shape identical, dtype float32, device cuda.
No broadcasting, no reduction.
Applies ConvTranspose2d with in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1, bias=True.
Input shape [512,3,40,40]; output shape [512,16,80,80] due to formula (40-1)*2 - 2*1 + 3 + 1 = 80.
Uses cuDNN for transposed convolution, adding bias after convolution.
Output dtype float32, device cuda.
Preserves NCHW layout.
Returns tensor from conv_transpose step.
Shape [512,16,80,80], dtype float32, device cuda.
